_: A small fictional chart for trying the seeder. Two bearings must exist first (create them in the app): 'Ship a CLI tool' and 'Write docs people use'. Run: python3 scripts/seed_chart.py --dry-run

edits.title: Ship a CLI tool
edits.description: A fictional example bearing. The tool counts words in markdown files; the point is the shape of the chart, not the tool.

nodes.title: The tool installs in one command
nodes.waypoint: pipx install on a clean machine puts a working `wordcount` on PATH
nodes.falsifier: a fresh VM needs any step beyond the one command

kids.title: CI runs the install on a clean image
kids.waypoint: the install job is green on the default branch

nodes.title: The quickstart runs exactly as written
nodes.waypoint: pasting the README quickstart into a fresh shell produces the documented output
nodes.falsifier: any quickstart line needs editing before it works

nodes.title: Errors say what to do next
nodes.waypoint: every non-zero exit prints the command that would fix it

nodes.title: Every flag has an example
nodes.waypoint: --help lists an example for each flag, and each example runs
